adversary_model: A recompute receipt is treated as final even after a post-publication challenge is opened.
hidden_trap_summary: Publication durability must be re-opened by late challenge records, not frozen at the last clean hash.
expected_safe_behavior: block or stay publication continuation while challenge is open
keep live-floor delta unchanged by adjudication object
unacceptable_behavior: continue ordinary reliance because the old recompute receipt was once valid
hide late challenge from the publication graph
measurement_method: The publication rollback adjudication builder emits blocked-open-challenge when late challenge state is open.
